remarks:
18 ACRES OF PRIVACY, SPACE & COUNTRY LIVING!

Welcome to 5101 Madden Road, where comfortable living meets the freedom of 18 beautiful acres in the country.  This well-maintained 3-bedroom, 2½-bath home offers  a finished lower level and  incredible outdoor spaces. 

Step inside through the impressive high-ceiling entry with exposed beams and you’ll immediately notice the warmth and character of this home. The kitchen features stainless appliances and a beautiful walnut island, while the primary suite offers a walk-in shower, soaking tub and spacious walk-in closet.

The finished lower level adds valuable  living space with an additional bedroom, newly updated spa type bathroom.  With a walk out double door and the French drains which have been installed behind the basement walls, this level offers endless possibilities.

Energy efficiency is a major bonus here, with a geothermal heating and cooling system and air-source heat-pump water heater installed in 2025, plus solar and a Tesla backup battery installed in 2026. The home also offers multiple supplemental heat sources, including two propane fireplaces and a pellet stove.

And then there’s the outdoor living! A remarkable approximately 750-square-foot covered deck provides plenty of room for entertaining and  relaxing. A stone patio, fire pit and raised garden beds create even more opportunities to enjoy the outdoors.

The property includes a two-story studio building with electric and water/septic lines in place, offering tremendous potential for a studio, workshop, guest space or future conversion.  


For those looking for land, privacy and outdoor recreation, the 18 acres have been managed for wildlife and currently include multiple food plots. The property features a mix of timber and open areas, with mature landscaping and plenty of room to garden, explore and enjoy nature.

If you’ve been looking for more than just a house—if you’re looking for room to breathe, room to garden, room to entertain and room to make the property your own—this could be the one.
